notes.title: 1.5 Update: In Case You Missed It!
notes.notes:
[h2]Just a quick reminder for all you champions out there! [/h2]

Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers is set to have its [b]1.5 update arrive today (June 30, 2022). [/b]

The update does include several fixes for the Skip Button, Typos, Misgendering, and more. However, when testing, we noticed that[b] it caused some Saved Games to become lost.[/b] Most notably, the saves made during the choice menu, while a voice line/sound FX is playing, or when a notable visual effect (such as pop-up animation) is activated. 

To reduce the chance of experiencing any issues [b]please save your game during a scene containing normal text dialogue. [/b]

Alternatively, while Steam will automatically update to 1.5, you can use these instructions to return to an earlier version of the game (version 1.3) if you find that your save was affected. 

To keep playing on your original save using version 1.3: 

[olist]
[*] Right-click on the app in the Steam library 
[*] Click "properties" 
[*] Select "betas" 
[*] Select "Rollback" from the opt-in dropdown 
[*] Steam should automatically update and begin downloading the selected version 
[/olist]
Again, we apologise for any inconvenience this update may cause but we hope you’ll continue your journey on either the 1.3 or 1.5 build of the game! 

For any questions or help, please hop onto the Steam Forums or join our amazing community on [b]Discord. [/b]

notes.title: Important 1.5 Update: Please Read!
notes.notes:
[h2]Important 1.5 Update: Please Read [/h2]

Hello again to all you Retro Romancers! 

We have an important update for you today regarding the [b]1.5 patch[/b] heading to [i][b]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers. [/b][/i]

The update will be released on June 30, 2022, and will include several fixes including:  

[list]
[*] Fix for the Skip button during new playthroughs. 
[*] Several fixes for the Linux version. 
[*] Typos and misgendering errors addressed. 
[*] A Content Warning has been added to show prior to starting Chapter 6. 
[/list]
However, while testing, we have noticed that this update may cause players to lose their [b][u]current Saved Games.[/u][/b] Most notably, the saves made during the choice menu, while a voice line/sound FX is playing, or when a notable visual effect (such as pop-up animation) is activated are among the affected.  

To reduce the chance of experiencing any issues please [b]save your game during a scene containing normal text dialogue.  [/b]

Alternatively, while Steam will [b]automatically update to 1.5[/b], you can use these instructions to return to an [b]earlier version of the game if you find that your save was affected.  
[/b]
[h2]To keep playing on your original save affected by 1.5: [/h2]

[list]
[*] Right-click on the app in the Steam library  
[*] Click "properties"  
[*] Select "betas" 
[*] Select "Rollback" from the opt-in dropdown 
[*] Steam should automatically update and begin downloading the selected version 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/b42f3814233d5605343093e825a3838e791a7f30.png[/img]

This should allow you to carry on your playthrough on the 1.3 build of the game. 

We apologise for any inconvenience this update may cause, but we hope you'll continue your journey to becoming the next FOD2 champion (whether that be on version 1.3 or 1.5!). 

For any questions or help, please hop onto the Steam Forums or join our amazing community on [b]Discord. [/b]

notes.title: New Character Trailer & Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
Hello to all you esports legends in the making!

We've got some exciting news as today we are officially announcing that [b]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/b] will be launching on [b]May 27 2022![/b]

To celebrate we've got a brand new character trailer to share, featuring the key players that you'll be encountering on your road to victory!

[previewyoutube=bMSRZPI2HoQ;full][/previewyoutube]

For those of you that missed them first time around, check out our previous posts to learn more about each character:
[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/5299049807141665960]Domino[/url] - A shy individual who struggles to form real attachments. While he may sometimes have a bleak outlook on life he will do anything for his friends.
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/5299049807142458204]Grace[/url] - A genius in her own right, she helped develop several pieces of innovative technology but prefers the life of an indie game developer.
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/5299049807160209374]Jynx[/url] - Don't let the icy stare scare you away. Jynx can come across as intimidating but in reality, she's just pragmatic while showing a fierce loyalty to those close to her and their needs. 
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3114804524534015579]Locksley[/url] - The thief with a heart of gold. As his namesake suggests, Locksley loves nothing more than helping those in need whilst attempting to bring down big corporations.
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3114804524555670811]Rhapsody[/url] - Knows everything there is to know about strategy. They are an expert in all things Fist of Discomfort related and a top-notch shoutcaster to top it off!
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3121561825584172895]Zapper[/url] - To say that she is passionate would be an understatement. Zapper is highly competitive and likes to do everything at 110%.
[/list]
We'd love to hear who your favorite character is so far, and who you are planning to get to know a little 'closer' upon release. All of the characters mentioned above can be a potential romantic partner, or your next best friend as you grow your fledgling esports team.

One thing is for certain though; win or lose, they've always got your back!

For players who are veterans of the series, remember that the choices that you made in the original [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/910630/Arcade_Spirits/] Arcade Spirits [/url]will carry over into [b]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/b], unlocking new subplots, character interactions, and Easter eggs! 

All you need to know:
